assertions.description: Clear normal affiche PICKUPS +N si pickupCount > 0
Boss clear affiche BOSS +N si bossHitCount > 0
Pas de ligne breakdown si pickupCount === 0 et bossHitCount === 0
assertions.condition: breakdownLabel.length === 0 → hasBreakdown = false → lineCount non incrémenté

assertions.description: TOTAL = runtimeScore = pickups + clear_bonus + boss_hits + time_bonus
assertions.condition: ClearScene affiche data.score = this.runtimeScore (GameScene) qui inclut tout

assertions.description: Best score non écrasé par score inférieur
assertions.condition: SaveSystem.recordBestScore() inchangé — isNewRecord = score > previousBest uniquement

assertions.description: pickupCount et bossHitCount remis à 0 au replay
GameOver affiche TOTAL (pas SCORE) pour cohérence terminologie
+X TEMPS toujours affiché sur Clear normal si timeBonus > 0

assertions.condition: Aucune modification des blocs boutons dans ClearScene/GameOverScene
